description: Case setup for Safe Appeals: post-welcome checklist, agent-native case briefs (AGENTS.md), and structured case info (.safeAppeals/case.json)
walkthrough.title: Get Started with Safe Appeals
walkthrough.description: A short checklist after welcome: confirm your profile, try the sample case, and connect the pieces you need.
walkthrough.reviewProfile.title: Review Your Profile
walkthrough.reviewProfile.description:
Confirm who you are, where you work, and what law you practice. Saved once on this computer and included in every case brief.
[Review Profile](command:safeappeals-case.setupProfile)
walkthrough.openSampleCase.title: Open the Sample Case
walkthrough.openSampleCase.description:
Explore a bundled practice matter with no credits and no client data — just enough to see how a case folder is laid out.
[Open Sample Case](command:safeappeals-case.openSampleCase)
walkthrough.takeTour.title: Take the Tour
walkthrough.takeTour.description:
A short guided look at the case files list, where Chat opens, and what an approval prompt looks like.
[Take the Tour](command:safeappeals-case.takeTour)
walkthrough.howUsesAI.title: Read How Safe Appeals Uses AI
walkthrough.howUsesAI.description:
What stays on this computer, what is sent when you ask the assistant a question, and your responsibility for reviewing every answer.
[How Safe Appeals Uses AI](command:safeappeals.help.howUsesAI)
walkthrough.addCredits.title: Add Credits
walkthrough.addCredits.description:
AI drafting and research run on credits. Your account starts at zero — nothing runs and nothing is charged until you buy a pack.
[Add Credits](command:safeappeals.cloud.openCheckout)
walkthrough.createCase.title: Create Your First Case
walkthrough.createCase.description:
Initialize the folder you have open with a case brief (AGENTS.md) and structured case info so the agent knows the client, opposing party, and key dates.
[Initialize Case Folder](command:safeappeals-case.initCase)
walkthrough.connect.title: Connect Email & Calendar
walkthrough.connect.description:
Link the inbox and calendar you already use so correspondence and deadlines stay with the case.
[Connect Email](command:safeappeals-email.addAccount)
[Connect Calendar](command:safeappeals-calendar.connect)
